types.name: ToolSlug
types.description: URL-safe identifier for each tool, used as route param and Convex page key.

types.name: StepNumber
types.description: Integer 1–11 representing the tool's position in the exemplar.tools workflow order.

types.name: HexColor
types.description: CSS hex color string (e.g. '#00e5ff') used for per-tool accent theming.

types.name: InstructionStep

fields.name: title
fields.description: Short human-readable title for this instruction step.

fields.name: bash
fields.description: Bash code block content to display in a terminal-styled card.

types.description: A single step-by-step instruction entry containing a human title and a bash snippet.

types.name: OptionalVideoUrl
types.description: YouTube embed URL if the tool has a video; undefined otherwise (e.g. kindex).

types.name: InstructionStepList
types.description: Ordered array of InstructionStep objects for a tool's how-to section.

types.name: ToolDef

fields.name: slug
fields.description: URL-safe identifier used as route parameter and sidebar key.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human-readable display name of the tool (e.g. 'Constrain').

fields.name: description
fields.description: One-line description shown on the tool page and in the quick-start table.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Workflow step number (1–11) displayed in the StepBadge.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Semver version string displayed in the VersionBadge.

fields.name: accentColor
fields.description: Per-tool accent color hex for badges, headings, and diagram nodes.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.description: YouTube embed URL; omitted for kindex.

fields.name: instructions
fields.description: Ordered step-by-step instructions rendered on the tool page.

types.description: Complete static definition of one tool including display metadata, instructions, and video URL.

types.name: ToolDefList
types.description: The canonical ordered array of all 11 ToolDef objects, indexed by workflow step order.

types.name: Comment

fields.name: _id
fields.description: Convex-generated unique document ID.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Tool slug identifying which page this comment belongs to.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Display name of the comment author.

validators.error_message: Author name must be between 1 and 100 characters.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Comment body text.

validators.error_message: Comment body must be between 1 and 2000 characters.

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Unix epoch millisecond timestamp set via Date.now() at insertion time.

types.description: A user-submitted comment persisted in Convex, displayed in the CommentsSection.

types.name: CommentList
types.description: Array of Comment objects returned by the listComments query, sorted by createdAt ascending.

types.name: AddCommentArgs

fields.name: page
fields.description: Tool slug identifying the target page.

fields.name: author
fields.description: Display name of the comment author.

validators.error_message: Author name must be non-empty and at most 100 characters.

fields.name: body
fields.description: Comment body text.

validators.error_message: Comment body must be non-empty and at most 2000 characters.

types.description: Arguments for the Convex addComment mutation, submitted from CommentsSection form.

types.name: ListCommentsArgs

fields.name: page
fields.description: Tool slug to filter comments by page.

types.description: Arguments for the Convex listComments query function.

types.name: SidebarItem

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Route parameter for navigation link.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Display name shown in the sidebar.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Step number rendered as a badge in the sidebar row.

fields.name: accentColor
fields.description: Accent color used to highlight the active sidebar item.

types.description: Derived view-model for a single sidebar navigation entry, projected from ToolDef.

types.name: DiagramNode

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Tool identifier for link target from diagram node.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Label rendered inside the diagram node.

fields.name: step
fields.description: Step number for ordering nodes around the circular layout.

fields.name: accentColor
fields.description: Fill/stroke color for this tool's node in the diagram.

types.description: Data for one node in the ClosedLoopDiagram SVG, projected from ToolDef.

types.name: DiagramNodeList
types.description: Ordered array of DiagramNode objects passed into the ClosedLoopDiagram component.

types.name: QuickStartRow

fields.name: step
fields.description: Step number column value.

fields.name: slug
fields.description: Route slug for the tool name link.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Tool display name rendered as a router link.

fields.name: description
fields.description: One-line description column value.

types.description: One row in the HomePage quick-start table, projected from ToolDef.
